def factor_range_vol_of_vol_robust_mad_median(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    mean_range_20 = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean()
    abs_dev = (range_ - mean_range_20).abs()
    mad_range = abs_dev.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean()
    median_range = range_.rolling(60, min_periods=20).median()
    ratio = mad_range / median_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = np.sign(-ratio) * np.sqrt(np.abs(-ratio))
    df_copy["factor_range_vol_of_vol_robust_mad_median"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_vol_of_vol_robust_mad_median"]
description: Preserves the core range vol-of-vol mean-reversion mechanism: high volatility of daily range relative to its typical level predicts lower forward returns. Mutates the parent by replacing the trailing 20-day standard deviation with a more robust trailing 20-day mean absolute deviation and the trailing 60-day mean denominator with a trailing 60-day median. The signed square-root compression is retained as the only lightweight modifier. This specifically targets the parent's failed top-quantile payoff thickness by reducing the influence of outlier wide-range days in both numerator and denominator, while keeping the stable monotonic ranking and RankICIR of the raw signal. Cross-sectional transform remains none to preserve the raw payoff mechanism.
